name: Chat2DB
description: AI-assisted database client for 40+ databases that generates, explains and optimises SQL with a model you bring.
whatItDoes: A database management tool for developers and DBAs with an assistant that drafts queries from natural language, explains existing SQL and suggests optimisations. It ships as a desktop app and as a self-hosted web service.
howItWorks: A Java backend with a web front end manages connections and sends schema context to the configured model. Recent beta builds add an optional local agent runtime with skills and external MCP servers, and a separate command-line client exposes MCP.

requirements.name: Docker
requirements.description: Docker 19.03+ and Compose 2.0+ for the self-hosted route

requirements.name: AI model credentials
requirements.description: Your own model endpoint for the assistant features
